linkedin_post:
"We'll just clean up the data after we move to the new CRM."

I hear this before almost every migration. It almost never happens.

Importing messy data into a new platform just means your team spends the first three months searching for the right phone number, arguing over duplicate records, and ignoring the new dashboard entirely.

Before you switch tools, take a weekend to audit what you actually have. Delete contacts who unsubscribed years ago, merge identical records, and make sure phone numbers follow one format.

Moving clean data takes patience. Moving messy data creates permanent headaches.
